---

## Q1 a Foundation

### Vision & Strategy
- Define product vision
- Target market & positioning
- Success metrics (KPIs)

### Core Architecture
- System design
- Tech stack selection
- Scalable infrastructure
- Security baseline
- DevOps pipeline (CI/CD)

### MVP Scope
- Core features only
- Fast iteration
- Internal testing

### Early Adopters
- Identify pilot users
- Feedback loop
- Usability improvements
- Bug fixing
- Product validation

### Operations Setup
- Project management
- Documentation
- Release process
- Monitoring & logging

---

## Q2 a Growth

### Product Expansion
- Improve core features
- Performance optimization
- UX/UI refinement
- Reliability & stability

### Integrations
- Third-party services
- API ecosystem
- Webhooks / automation
- Partner onboarding

### Team Expansion
- Hire key roles
- Engineering scale
- Product & design support
- DevOps maturity

### Go-To-Market
- Marketing strategy
- Pricing model
- Acquisition channels
- Community building

### Data & Analytics
- Usage tracking
- Product metrics
- A/B testing
- Growth insights

---

## Beyond Q2 (Optional)

### Scaling
- High availability
- Global deployment
- Cost optimization

### Advanced Features
- Automation
- AI / intelligence
- Enterprise readiness

### Business Maturity
- Partnerships
- Revenue optimization
- Long-term roadmap
